Plan: crew/agent model rework (ordered per bead).

Slice 1 (this session):
1. VERIFY omp provider config: opencode-go + zai + opencode providers present so omp --model=glm-5.2 / deepseek-v4-flash / big-pickle routes. Surface missing provider as blocker BEFORE touching profiles.
2. models.toml: add deepseek-v4-flash (opencode-go), big-pickle (opencode); glm-5.2 (zai) exists; add grok-premium fallback. Per-model effort caps where supported.
3. profile.rs compiled_in_defaults: harness=omp for all 6; model+effort per map (oracle glm-5.2/grok-fallback, planner/reviewer/coder/housekeeper deepseek-v4-flash, scout big-pickle).
4. Retry-on-429: spawn + __run-headless catch 429, retry with model fallback (oracle glm-5.2 -> grok). Thin dynamic-routing slice.
5. Gate: profile list shows 6 on omp; headless oracle run uses glm-5.2, forced 429 -> grok, transitions logged in runs/<id>.jsonl; omp routing reaches deepseek-v4-flash.

Locks: flywheel/src/{profile,models,headless,main,config}.rs. Files in ~/workspace/flywheel.
